args.query: federal public lands acreage BLM Forest Service

sql: SELECT mang_name, SUM(acres) ac, COUNT(*) n FROM lands.padus_federal_fee_lands GROUP BY mang_name ORDER BY ac DESC FETCH FIRST 8 ROWS ONLY
